prefill.notes: Requires continue_final_message + add_generation_prompt=false + chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false. Without continue_final_message, assistant prefix is treated as complete. With thinking on, prefill may be ignored in favor of fresh reasoning.

thinking.default: enabled; answer appears in message.reasoning with content=null until max_tokens exhausted

judge.limitation: same-model-judge per whitepaper §6.3 — must state in writeup
